# svg

Headless SVG and PNG output: `chartToSvg` and `sceneToSvg` give SVG text, `composeSvg` puts charts and labels in one document, `svgToPng` and `svgToPixels` rasterise it in a browser, `encodePng` writes PNG bytes with no dependency, and `exportSize` gives the size for a page, blog post or slide.

- function `chartToSvg`: A chart to SVG text: `chartToSvg(option, { width, height })`. `src/svg/export.ts:31` `omai-render/svg`
- function `composeSvg`: Charts and labels in one SVG document: `composeSvg(width, height, parts)`. `src/svg/export.ts:76` `omai-render/svg`
- function `encodePng`: RGBA pixels to PNG file bytes, with no dependency: `encodePng(pixels)`. `src/svg/png.ts:134` `omai-render/svg`
- function `exportSize`: Export size of a figure for a page, blog or slide: `exportSize(fig, 'slide')`. `src/svg/export.ts:218` `omai-render/svg`
- function `sceneToSvg`: A Scene to standalone SVG text: `sceneToSvg(scene, { mode: 'dark' })`. `src/svg/svg.ts:149` `omai-render/svg`
- function `svgToPixels`: SVG text to RGBA pixels in a browser: `svgToPixels(svg, width, height)`. `src/svg/export.ts:191` `omai-render/svg`
- function `svgToPng`: SVG text to a PNG data URL in a browser: `svgToPng(svg, width, height)`. `src/svg/export.ts:168` `omai-render/svg`
